items.title: The Bull Case For Uber Technologies (UBER) Could Change Following Nationwide Costco Delivery Expansion Via Uber Eats
items.summary: Uber Technologies and Costco Wholesale Corporation recently expanded their U.S. partnership, taking Costco delivery via Uber Eats from 17 states to 47 and adding nearly 600 warehouse locations, giving members nationwide access to same-day delivery of groceries and household essentials through the Uber Eats app. This expansion not only deepens Uber’s role in large-scale retail delivery but also ties Costco members more closely into the Uber One ecosystem via discounted memberships, gift cards...
